As a person who loves online multiplayer shooters I'm happy to add Polygon to my collection. First of all I loved the maps. They are well designed and easy to learn. Variety of buildings, cars, blocks makes the maps enjoyable to play. Graphics are eye-catching and very compatible for comfortable action gaming.

I do really enjoy the game! Sadly the player base is small at the moment, but once that picks up I think this could be an excellent game. I would like to be able to use a controller with it, I tried and could not get it to work. That could be due to user error. I know there are some issues that will be hammered out in time. I really enjoy the map design, it has a nice mix of long, mid and close quarter. I can't wait to see what's to come!
